expectations.text: Identifies at least 2 of the 3 voice pipeline implementations
expectations.evidence: Found 2 of 4: voice_service.py:94 and engine.py:155. MISSED service_mediator.py and server.py (gRPC path)

expectations.text: Warns that changing only one location leaves other launch modes unchanged
expectations.evidence: Lists the two locations as 'Primaer' and 'Sekundaer' but does NOT warn about the missing service_mediator.py and server.py locations. A user following this would leave 2 launch modes still saying 'Ja, Sir?'

expectations.text: Suggests using pygame.mixer or similar audio playback for the confirmation sound
